featured_reviews.name: BhataktiAatmaWasHere
featured_reviews.review_text:
Faredoon is a Persian name meaning pure, blessed, lucky, fortunate — which already feels like a promise before you even take a bite.

Tucked inside El Plaza at I.C. Colony (a residential building that has quietly turned into a full-time food court), Faredoon's is easy to miss if you blink. the interiors are bright, inviting and aesthetically done.

I sampled the Salli Chicken Bun, Chicken Kheema Pav Bun, the Non-Veg Trio Croissant, a Brownie Pound slice cake, and a Caramel Cream Puff. And honestly? Not a single misstep. The breads are pillowy-soft, the fillings generous (borderline indulgent), and the flavours… dangerously addictive. The kind that make you question why you didn’t order one more for later.

A special shoutout to Pratik for the prompt, warm service — the kind that makes the experience feel effortless and welcoming.
It’s also easy on the pocket, which in today’s economy deserves a separate round of applause.

So yes, Faredoon's lives up to its name. I walked in curious, walked out blessed, and returned home feeling incredibly lucky. Fortune, in this case, clearly favours the hungry. 🍀

featured_reviews.name: S D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrid story to tell about theobroma i c colony giving us a HALF BAKED WET CHEESECAKE!!

So it was my mothers 68th birthday yesterday 30 Nov 2024. I ordered her a surprise cake from the theobroma store thats just 300m from home. We didnt check it as it was a surprise for my mother.

In the evening we opened the cake from the fridge & saw that the CHEESECAKE WAS RUNNY AND LIQUID!!! The letters on the cake were moving, attached pic above.The plastic around couldnt be removed as the cake would overflow!! The baker honestly didnt bake it right. WE SANG HAPPY BIRTHDAY BUT MUMMY DIDNT CUT THE CAKE!!! SEE PHOTO.

What a disappointment to see my mother unable to cut the cake as it was liquid. She was sad, we felt so bad to see her unable to cut the liquid cake. Our guests left without eating cake as well. We were embarrased in front of guests and friends, giving mummy a bad unbaked cake. We went out to dinner anyway & put the cake in fridge to try it out today 1Dec, thinking maybe it needed to set properly. Complaining at 10pm was not a priority as we didnt want to ruin the evening further for mummy.

Today morning 1 Dec we checked it again at 11am, its still sticky, and not set. Its like icecream and stickier. Finally i took pictures today 1 Dec at 12pm after removing the plastic & it fell apart!! I called theobroma to address the issue. After forwarding them pics on whatsapp, i get the response "Thank you for the feedback. We cannot help you as its 24 hours passed"

They expected us to call them in front of our guests last night at 10pm to complain 🤦‍♀️ Very disappointed to say the least. The evening was ruined as mom stood to cut cake & there was no cake as it was liquid. It hadnt set.The baker didnt bake it correctly.

Im a regular customer & yet they didnt have the courtesy to offer to repair the damage done especially given the occasion of a birthday of a senior. Or even return the money. The cake is as it is, see below pic. Its shape changed because it overflowed.

Never will i return back or recommend. Thanks for ruining a birthday. Here i am on my day off, complaining, only to be unheard. Where are your ethics when you managed to ruin a birthday,& yet show no courtesy to customer grievances?

The cake is still at home, uneaten and uncut. What a horrible birthday we had because of theobroma i c colony staff. She will never forget this bad experience.

I had a very disappointing experience at Sweet Country Cake Shop. From the moment I walked in, the service felt unprofessional and inattentive. The staff seemed uninterested in helping customers and lacked basic courtesy. I had to wait quite a long time just to place my order, even though the shop wasn’t particularly busy.

The quality of the cake itself was far below expectations. The design looked rushed and nothing like what was promised. The cake was overly sweet to the point of being unpleasant, and the texture was dry instead of soft and fresh. It honestly felt like it had been sitting out for too long before being served.

Hygiene was another concern. The display area didn’t look clean, and I noticed crumbs and smudges on the counter, which made me question the overall cleanliness of the kitchen as well.

Considering the price they charge, the experience and product quality do not justify the cost at all. There are definitely much better bakeries out there offering fresher, tastier cakes with far better service.

Overall, I would not recommend Sweet Country Cake Shop. It was a waste of money and time, and I won’t be returning.

We've been ordering cakes from them for almost every occasion at our home be it birthday's or anniversaries. The taste has been good so far until recently where we had issues with our order and that kind of ruined the customer experience for us.
We purchased their KitKat cake for a birthday celebration and when we cut it during the celebration, we felt a very odd taste.. it didn't feel like it was a fresh cake as they claimed it to be. The next morning, the first thing we did was called them and informed them about this and we were told to get the cake to them and they'll see what can be done, we did so. Upon reaching, they checked the cake and told us that since half of the cake was consumed they couldn't refund but would replace it with a PASTRY (we paid ₹500 for it, but they wanted to give us a PASTRY as a compensation), mind you, the cake wasn't consumed, we had to throw half of it when we distributed it during the celebration due to the odd taste and risk of causing any health complications. They initially denied and told they couldn't do anything about it and upon explaining them about how often we buy from them and how unfair it would be to compensate with a pastry for a cake, they agreed to give us a fresh cake.
An odd experience but they did agree to give us a fresh cake. Hope they do something about this experience I've had so no one else has to face it.

featured_reviews.name: Aiman Behlim
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Theobroma Café in Borivali, and once again, it proved why it’s one of the best cafés in Mumbai! I tried the Chicken Makhani Sandwich and the Chicken Mayo 🥪 —both were absolutely loaded, bursting with flavor, and made with fresh, soft bread. Every bite was mouth-watering and satisfying, served with a tasty side of sauce that perfectly complemented the sandwiches. For dessert, I went for the Hazelnut pastry 🍰 and wow—just wow! The rich, exotic mousse simply melted in my mouth, with the fine taste of hazelnut shining through in every bite. It was pure indulgence—yum yum yummm! The café also offers fresh loaves of bread, chocolate spreads, and more. If you’re ever craving something delicious, whether savory or sweet, Theobroma is a must-visit!🎖️

featured_reviews.name: Ayyub Kolsawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This doesnt need any introductions. After a heavy dinner at Maa Anjaani pav bhaji, we went straight for desserts at Theobroma.

Theobroma wasn’t always my go-to place but it has recently become one. Not only do they serve delicious brownies, their pastries are also pretty good.

Fresh Cream Pineapple Pastry ♥️🔥: A very simple yet delicious pastry. I absolutely love their cream and pineapple filling which makes a perfect combination. It’s not too sweet making it perfect for a post dinner dessert item. Must try even if you don’t enjoy fruit cakes, this will leave you craving for it.

Hazelnut Praline Mousse Cake ♥️: When I am craving a chocolate cake, this is the one I go for. Its delicious!

New York Style Cheesecake ♥️: It was delicious and definitely worth trying.

Sourdough Bread ♥️: Recently I purchased their sourdough bread for sandwiches and after lightly toasting the bread, I was very happy with it’s texture and flavour. They charge 120 for it which makes it extremely valuable for the money spent.
